info.name: Learning
info.summary: Spaced Repetition Learning with Leitner System
info.description:
**Learning** is a powerful flashcard and quiz app for Nextcloud with a built-in Leitner 5-box spaced repetition system.
Create question pools, share them with your team, and study efficiently using scientifically-proven spaced repetition.
## Features
- **Multiple Choice Quizzes** — Create pools with questions and multiple answers - **Leitner Spaced Repetition** — 5-box system with automatic scheduling (1d, 3d, 7d, 14d intervals) - **Pool Sharing** — Share pools with other users (read or edit permissions) - **CSV/JSON Import** — Bulk import questions from CSV or JSON files - **Dashboard Widget** — See due questions at a glance from the Nextcloud Dashboard - **Progress Tracking** — Stats, accuracy, mastery percentage per pool - **Mobile Optimized** — Touch-friendly responsive design with swipe gestures - **Course Management** — Instructors can create courses, assign pools, and track student progress - **Multi-Language Support** — Translate questions and answers into any language - **Exam Mode** — Timed exams with configurable question count - **Search** — Full-text search across all your question pools
## Use Cases
- Employee Onboarding & Compliance Training - IT Certification Prep (CompTIA, Cisco, AWS) - University Courses & Exam Preparation - Language Learning Vocabulary - General Knowledge Retention
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 29, 30, or 31 - PHP 8.1+ - PostgreSQL 13+ or MySQL 8+
